explanation: Head-on elastic collision with 100:1 mass ratio (20 vs 0.2) produced a non-physical slingshot: light body went from -62 m/s to -598 m/s while heavy body dropped 59.7 to 4.3 m/s, violating momentum conservation. At ~598 m/s the per-substep displacement (~0.28m with 70 substeps) exceeds the 0.1m wall thickness, so the centre crossed through wall 0 between steps 80 and 81.
